name: InputGroup
description:
Plain div composition on Theya tokens, no library dependency. A
borderless InputGroupInput sits with InputGroupAddon segments inside
one bordered container that shares one focus-within ring — following
TextField's conventions (height, focus-ring token, and the border+bg
pairing on error) so this input-shaped component doesn't drift from it.
whenToUse: A fixed prefix or suffix that is part of the value’s format: https://, .theya.app, /mo, GB.
A button that belongs to the field, inside its border.

anatomy.description: one border and one focus ring for the whole group.
borderless; the container draws the border.

do.caption: The fixed part is shown, not typed.
do.example: .theya.app

dont.caption: Asking people to type the fixed part invites typos.
dont.example: <TextField label="Subdomain" defaultValue="shop.theya.app" widthSize="md" description="Must end with .theya.app" />

a11y: Label the input itself (htmlFor its id). The addon is visible text, not part of the name — repeat it in the description if it matters.
Errors go on the input (aria-invalid + described message) — the group shows them together.
